senses.gloss: m. (reduplic. of סור; cmp. Arab. sursûr) going around, examination; (sub. בעל) expert, middleman, broker (cmp. סַפְסָר, סַפְסִירָא).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:8">B. Bath. V, 8</cite> <he>אם היה ס׳ ביניהן … לס׳</he> if a middleman is between them, and the cask is broken (before delivery to the purchaser), the middleman has to suffer the loss; <cite ref="Bava Batra 87a:9">ib. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>במדת ס׳</he> when the vessel belonged to the middleman; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:12">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>נשברה החבית נשברה לס׳</he>; Tanḥ. Ekeb 11 (corr. acc.). Gen. R. R. s. 8 <he>עשה לו סחורה ע״י ס׳</he> had business done through a commissioner.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:16">Koh. R. to X, 16</cite> <he>הדיין יושב … והס׳ מכריע וכ׳</he> the judge is seated, the parties stand, and the mediator tries to compromise between them.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:4">Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ</cite> top <he>כשם שנתנה ע״י ס׳ וכ׳</he> as the Law was given through an agent (Moses), so it must be taught through an agent (the Amora, v. <cite ref="A02003"><he>אֲמוֹרָא</he></cite>). Pesik. Haḥod., p. 45ᵃ <he>הס׳</he> the agent (Moses); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>פני הס׳</he> (strike out <cite ref="U01281"><he>השליט</he></cite> or <he>השליח</he>, as a gloss to <he>הס׳</he>).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:53">Lam. R. to I, 18</cite> <he>פיהו ופום סִרְסוּרוֹ</he> against his commandment and that of his agent (the prophet); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:9">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:24">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵃ</cite> top <he>הס׳</he> the agent of sin, v. <cite ref="K01007"><he>כָּפָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>סִרְסוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="O01613"><he>סִירְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 17:6">Num. R. s. 17</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 15:39">Num. XV, 39</cite>) <he>הלב … ס׳ לגוף</he> the heart and the eyes are the body’s agents (panders); Tanḥ.Sh’laḥ 15; a. fr.
